prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer:
**Sheriff William “Billy” C. Getman** was the most recent Los Angeles County sheriff killed in the line of duty. He was shot and killed on **January 7, 1858**, while confronting an armed man in Los Angeles.

*(If referring to any LASD personnel, the most recent were Detectives Joshua Kelley-Eklund, Victor Lemus, and William Osborn, killed in the July 18, 2025 training-facility explosion.)*
